I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

- **Where it comes from:** Priyanka's posts in that channel on 3 Sep 2025. She said label printing stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and Southgate dispatch had totes stacked by door 4. When she closed the incident that evening, she said Southgate had cleared the backlog. Tobias is a member of the channel, so he can see all of this himself.
- **What I couldn't find:** an address or any other details for the Southgate site. The files Tobias can see include nothing for Tansley Parcel. I told him that and suggested he check the account record before the call.
